title: Charlemagne and the tyrants of the air

tellings.quote: It was so prominent that hysteria broke out about it in the French court and Charlemagne was considering declaring war on the tyrants of the air.

plain: In Charlemagne's time, sightings in the sky over France are said to have been so common that panic broke out at the French court, and Charlemagne thought about declaring war on the "tyrants of the air." The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells this on the show, drawing on The Gods of Eden, a book by the writer William Bramley. If true, it would mean people were reporting strange things in the sky long before modern UFO sightings.
